messages:
Mira Patel: heads up — customer sent over a new tiny LLM they want hosted: fogwing-2b (fp16 weights, sac-tokenizer). can we triage? attaching model tar in the workspace.
Jon Kim: can you paste model config & vocab? also, is this a derivative of a known arch (gptj / llama-like)? :eyes:
Mira Patel: config.json pasted in the bucket: model_type: 'decoder_only', layers: 24, hidden: 2560, vocab_size: 50288. tokenizer is sac-tokenizer with unk/cls/pad. no special fast tokenizer yet. customer says latency-sensitive chat usage.
Ivy Chen: network question — will this live on Dedicated or Private? needs VPC allowlist if private. also what's retention/compliance tier?
Mira Patel: likely Dedicated for now (customer asked for reserved). compliance: standard (no HIPAA).
Nate R.: I can run a quick quant pass (GPTQ/awq) and measure quality. do we have a labeled eval set or few-shot prompts from the customer?
Mira Patel: customer provided 120 prompts / 5-shot pairs and a few safety flags. uploaded to /evals/fogwing-2b/seed_prompts.jsonl.
Jon Kim: plan: 1) smoke load in FP16 -> perf baseline 2) run INT8 (GPTQ/awq) -> compare PPL and exact-match on eval set 3) run safety & hallucination checks 4) canary on Dedicated staging. create rollback plan.
Nate R.: starting GPTQ-INT8 run now. command: ```python run_quant.py --model /mnt/models/fogwing-2b --method gptq --bits 8 --out /tmp/fogwing-2b-gptq``` will log to quant-lab.
QuantLab Bot: quant job started (job_id=q-7812). estimated 45m. memory: 40GB.
Mira Patel: small request: please also try a symmetric int8 path and a 4-bit awq path if time permits — customer cares about cost.
Nate R.: noted. I'll run 8-bit first then awq-4 if 8-bit drops quality >3% on primary metric.
Jon Kim: what metrics are we using? PPL + instruction-response BLEU? maybe ROUGE-lite + hallucination rate from the safety harness.
Mira Patel: customer primary metric: coherent answer rate (binary) + latency 95th < 200ms for single-token streaming on Dedicated.
Ivy Chen: Dedicated staging allocated 1xA10 pool for canary. Deploy Bot will post when nodes are ready.
Deploy Bot: Dedicated staging pool ready (pool_id=stg-fogwing). canary route created. :rocket:
QuantLab Bot: quant job q-7812 finished. results: fp16 -> baseline PPL 3.9, int8 (gptq) -> PPL 4.1, coherent rate delta -2.2%. latency FP16 90th = 180ms, INT8 90th = 110ms. logs: /logs/q-7812/*.
Nate R.: int8 looks promising — slight quality drop but under threshold. will run awq-4 now to compare cost delta.
Jon Kim: checklist reminder: - tokenizer compatibility test (no OOV crashes) - KV-cache consistency smoke - beam/greedy parity on short inputs - streaming chunking behavior - fallback policy to fp16 if model times out
Mira Patel: added those to ticket INF-4123. tagging @Jon Kim @Nate R. for follow-ups.
Ivy Chen: once quant artifact is validated, ops needs the artifact path and checksum, plus docker runtime args. also add model metadata: quant_method, bits, compiler/kernels used.
Nate R.: posting awq-4 quick numbers: PPL 4.6, coherent_rate -6.5% -> too large a drop. will produce final INT8 artifact and run longer eval on 1k prompts overnight.
Jon Kim: good call. For canary, start with 5% traffic split and 15-min health window. auto-rollback on coherent_rate drop >3% or error rate + latency SLOs.
Mira Patel: agreed. I'll coordinate with Customer Success to schedule the canary time.
QuantLab Bot: overnight eval queued (job_id=q-7824) on 1k prompts, ETA 7h.
Ivy Chen: ops request: provide the exact startup CMD we expect the serving runtime to run (env vars, quant artifact path). send as snippet here.
Mira Patel: snippet: ```CMD ["/usr/bin/redwood-runtime", "--model", "/artifacts/fogwing-2b-int8", "--quant", "gptq-8", "--kv_cache", "enabled", "--streaming", "enabled"]```
Nate R.: results from overnight 1k eval: coherent_rate drop -2.4% (stat sig within margin), latency 95th = 115ms. recommending INT8 artifact for Dedicated.
Jon Kim: action items: Nate -> finalize artifact + checksum, Mira -> coordinate canary with CS, Ivy -> prepare pool & IAM, Deploy Bot -> schedule 5% canary. Marking P0 -> P1 depending on customer deadline.
Mira Patel: thanks all. will update INF-4123 with final artifact and canary window. :thumbsup:
